tactical_patterns.pattern: Batting-first vs chasing — overall IPL dataset
tactical_patterns.description: Across 1,218 completed IPL matches in this dataset, batting-first teams won 552 (45.3%) and chasing teams won 666 (54.7%).
tactical_patterns.exploiting_approach: Consider venue-specific batting-first win rates when deciding toss strategy. Conditions vary significantly by ground and time of day.

tactical_patterns.pattern: Powerplay scoring impact on match outcome
tactical_patterns.description: Average powerplay score (batting first) across 1,243 matches: 47.7 runs. In 407 matches where the batting team scored 52.7+ in the powerplay, the batting team won 234 (57.5%).
tactical_patterns.exploiting_approach: Restrict opponents to below 47.7 runs in the powerplay. Early wickets significantly limit final total potential.

tactical_patterns.pattern: Chennai Super Kings — strong chasing record
tactical_patterns.description: Chennai Super Kings wins 60.7% when chasing (74/122 chases). Avg first innings score (when they bat first): 170.9.
tactical_patterns.exploiting_approach: Bat first against Chennai Super Kings and set a large target above their average chase target. Restrict powerplay to limit scoring platform.
